newsitem.title: USA: General Electric unit leases 35,500 railcars.
newsitem.headline: General Electric unit leases 35,500 railcars.

text.p: GE Capital Railcar Services, a unit of General Electric Co's GE Capital Co, said Monday it leased 35,500 railcars from St. Louis-based ACF Industries Inc railcar fleet.
GE Capital Railcar will manage the cars and provide service to the existing lessees. The transaction includes primarily tank and plastic pellet cars under 16-year leases with a purchase option.
ACF will continue to operate as a railcar manufacturer and lessor of railcars, including the remainder of its fleet.
